title: Grounded 2 Rot and Ruin update (this fall): Woodpile area, Termites and Termite King, Centipede boss, Potato Beetle Buggy, Painting with the Splotcher, Bismuth tiers

sources.note: Xbox Wire 20 Oct 19:00Z; 'when Rot and Ruin arrives in Grounded 2 this fall'; Game Preview on Xbox, Steam Early Access and PS5; 1.0 in 2027
Steam announcement 20 Oct 19:07Z; public test build since 6 Oct

sources.url: Steam 2661300 'Rot & Ruin' trailer; Xbox Wire screenshots
sources.note: decode clean; hook is the trailer's Centipede, stills are Xbox Wire's own images

claims.text: Woodpile area; Termites return incl. Termite King and new O.G.R.R. variants
Centipede boss, one of the community's most requested creatures
Potato Beetle Buggy: bigger than the Ladybug Buggy, close-range combat, hauls resources
Painting with the Splotcher; Bismuth and the Yoking Press for higher tiers

dl.headline:
حشرة أم أربع وأربعين
زعيم جديد في Grounded 2
dl.notes: Brief: hook = the surprise (the Centipede boss); format stills (clipcard would be a third in a row; trailer and split capped; the trailer is mostly dark caves and English title cards, so Xbox Wire's own screenshots show each feature better); opener: the trailer's Centipede (40.0 to 42.0 s) under the headline, then the bright Woodpile tunnel; line 1 (Woodpile, Termites) on the player with a torch and a Termite; line 2 (Potato Beetle Buggy) on the buggy; line 3 (painting) on the paint set; under it the trailer's score from 22 s (tonal throughout, measured). 15.6 s. 'This fall' in the caption and X text. Arabic: both skills; Centipede «أم أربع وأربعين», Termites «النمل الأبيض», Potato Beetle «خنفساء البطاطس», Ladybug «الدعسوقة». Grammar: no required edits. DeepL back-check read «أم أربع وأربعين زعيمًا» as '44 leaders': headline, X text and caption now say «حشرة أم أربع وأربعين»; v1 not posted.
dl.approved: go: rolling queue; preview sent 06:06Z; gate 05:35Z and 06:05Z: Xbox Wire post and Steam announcement read (this fall, no date), nothing newer
